theorems.label: independent-set-rankwidth-w1
theorems.statement: Assuming deterministic FPT ≠ W[1], there is no deterministic effective 2^(o(p²)) N^(O(1)) Independent Set algorithm on triangle-free graphs by either intrinsic width, with or without an optimal corresponding certificate.

theorems.label: independent-set-rankwidth-sh
theorems.statement: Assuming deterministic SH, for every fixed 0<ε<2 there is no deterministic 2^(O(p^(2−ε))) N^(O(1)) Independent Set algorithm on triangle-free graphs by either intrinsic width, with or without an optimal corresponding certificate.

title: Quadratic lower bounds for Independent Set on triangle-free graphs
